indicators: Inputs (source declarations): option_ch=input.string('Pullback',title = "Type Of Strategy",options =['Pullback','Simple']); atrPeriod = input(10, "ATR Length",group = group_text0); factor = input.float(3.0, "Factor", step = 0.01,group=group_text0); on_ma=input.bool(true,"Ema Condition On/Off",group=group_text0000); ma_len= input.int(200, minval=1, title="Ema Length",group = group_text0000); ma_src = input.source(close, title="Ema Source",group = group_text0000); en_rsi = input.bool(true,"Rsi Condition On/Off",group = group_text00); rsiSource = input(title='RSI Source', defval=close,group = group_text00); rsiLength = input(title='RSI Length', defval=14,group = group_text00); rsiOverbought = input(title='RSI BUY Level', defval=50,group = group_text00); rsiOversold = input(title='RSI SELL Level', defval=50,group = group_text00); start = input.time(timestamp('2005-01-01'), title='Start calculations from',group=group_text1); end=input.time(timestamp('2045-03-01'), title='End calculations',group=group_text1); tradeDirection = input.string(title='Trade Direction', options=['Long', 'Short', 'Both'], defval='Both',group = group_text2); stopPer = input.float(1.0,step=0.10, title='Stop Loss %',group =group_text4) / 100; takePer = input.float(1.0,step =0.10, title='Take Profit %',group =group_text4) / 100 | Indicator calls: Supertrend (ATR); ta.supertrend(factor, atrPeriod); ta.ema(ma_src, ma_len); ta.rsi(rsiSource, rsiLength)
entry_long: Source rule: buy_cond with all conditions true longOK with all conditions true time_cond with all conditions true strategy.position_size equals 0
entry_short: Source rule: sell_cond with all conditions true shortOK with all conditions true time_cond with all conditions true strategy.position_size equals 0
exit: Source rule: strategy.position_size  exceeds  0; order: strategy.exit(id='Close Long',stop=longStop, limit=longTake); Source rule: strategy.position_size  is below  0; order: strategy.exit(id='Close Short',stop=shortStop, limit=shortTake)
stop_loss: strategy.exit(id='Close Long',stop=longStop, limit=longTake); strategy.exit(id='Close Short',stop=shortStop, limit=shortTake)
take_profit: strategy.exit(id='Close Long',stop=longStop, limit=longTake); strategy.exit(id='Close Short',stop=shortStop, limit=shortTake)
position_sizing: Source strategy() declaration determines defaults when present; no exchange risk budget is inferred. See source for qty/default_qty_type/default_qty_value.
filters: Only conditions present in the cited source are represented in entry rules; no external filters added.
implementation_notes: Paraphrased from the cited Pine source file. Third-party Pine source; verify execution timing, pyramiding, and broker-emulator semantics before implementation.
